_note: Single source of truth for image/video placeholders. tools/build_placeholders.py renders assets/img/ph/<id>.jpg and docs/PHOTO_BRIEF.md from this file. 'ref' = reference file in assets/img/ref or assets/video. 'reshoot' = what must change before the frame can be published.

slots.title: Hero film loop
slots.shoot: Landscape. 3–4 silent clips of 8–12 s, camera fixed: hands sewing, the line, marker paper on the lay, hanging store. Nobody looks at camera. LED rows and the red-brown floor in frame.
slots.reshoot: Reference clips are portrait phone footage; shoot landscape, steady, and without customer hangers or tags in frame.

slots.title: Hero still (shown while film loads, and on slow connections)
slots.shoot: High angle across the production hall or the hanging store, landscape, one side quiet for the headline.
slots.reshoot: Landscape version; remove customer hangers/tags from the front rail.

slots.reshoot: Replace customer hangers with plain hangers; remove swing tags.
